title: Stone Age vs Today: Who Really Lived BETTER?
title_alternatives: Would You Survive a Week as a Stone Age HUMAN?
They Worked Less and Moved More. So Why Did We CHANGE?
Half Their Kids Died, Yet They Had More FREE TIME
The Stone Age Was Better at FOUR Things
Stone Age Life vs Modern Life: The Honest SCORE
description:
Half of all Stone Age children never grew up, yet many adults lived past seventy and had more free time than we do. Eight rounds, real studies of today's hunter-gatherers, and an honest final score.

This video is history and science, not medical advice.
